Pizza 4P's Guest Service
Dear Ms./Mr. Никита,

My name is Ngoc Phuong, Manager of Pizza 4P’s Nha Trang. Thank you very much for choosing Pizza 4P’s Nha Trang and for taking the time to share your valuable feedback with us.

We sincerely apologize for not being able to assist you with a table in a timely manner and for the miscommunication that affected your experience at our restaurant.
As Nha Trang is currently in its peak tourist season, our restaurant experiences a very high volume of guests, and many tables are reserved in advance. As a result, there are times when we may be fully booked.

According to our standard procedure, when guests arrive, our reception team will ask whether they have made a reservation so that we can provide the most appropriate assistance. If a guest does not have a reservation, we will still check table availability and arrange seating whenever possible. In cases where no tables are available, our team should inform guests of the estimated waiting time and collect their contact information if they are willing to wait.

After reviewing your feedback, we realized that our receptionist did not clearly explain this process. The question regarding whether you had a reservation may have unintentionally given the impression that we only accept guests with prior reservations, which is not our policy.
We have since held a meeting with our team to discuss your feedback and reinforce the importance of providing clear and proactive communication. Moving forward, our staff will make sure to clearly explain table availability and available options from the moment guests inquire about seating, in order to avoid similar misunderstandings.

Your feedback is a valuable opportunity for Pizza 4P’s to improve and bring better experiences to our guests in the future. We sincerely hope to have the chance to welcome and serve you again soon.

Thank you once again for your feedback, and I wish you a wonderful day.
Sincerely,
Ngoc Phuong

Disappointing dinner, not flavorful and delicious as we expected
Mar 2026 • Couples
We love Pizza 4Ps in Hanoi and we’re so excited to find one here. However dinner tonight at the 4Ps in Nha Trang was disappointing. 

It started with the shrimp avocado salad. In Hanoi it was so so delicious, full of fresh flavored avocado and chunks of shrimp. In Nha Trang we could hardly find the avocado, it was so sparse! And they put plenty of raw green beans in it, which really gave it an off-putting overly raw taste. 

Second was the clam chowder. It was watery and did not have nice chunks of clam, it was mostly liquid with a bit of celery, maybe mushroom? and some bits of clam, and the flavor was just not there. 

The crab pasta was ok, average. I was going to split it well my husband but after tasting it there was a strong fishy taste that was not expected so I passed. 

The last dish was the miso scallop pizza. It was ok. The bread crust was nice but somehow it was not delicious. 

Overall the best thing about the meal was the home made ginger ale soda, which came with ginger sauce, simple syrup and Schweppes, which was nice. 

I wish I had more positive things to say as 4Ps was one of our most favorite restaurants in Hanoi, but this location is just so different it almost feels like it’s not the same brand of quality.

We booked online and on arrival we were taken to our table. The entrance area has a large outdoor eating area, which is great to people watch. However, we were taken another area within the Sheraton Hotel that lacked ambience, just a large room with glazed panel walls. 
It was very busy and I’m glad we had booked, otherwise we would been waiting for a while. 
We ordered spaghetti Bolognese and a Margarita pizza and a couple of drinks. 
The bolognese turned up quite quickly and was lovely, however, the pizza was not so good. I know it was a basic pizza, but I’d hoped for it to taste a little better than it did. 
I’d give it another try, but it wasn’t the experience I’d hoped for. 
Saying that, it only cost us 448,000 VND (£13-44) for the pair of us, so you gets what you pay for.
